page.notes: The small "»" marks at the start of many lines are not transcribed; they look like line-start marks, not words. The handwritten ink annotation in the left margin ("De optimo genere iuris interpretandi" or similar) is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. The running head at the top is decorated and not readable with certainty. "sig." is read from "fig."; the long s is written as plain s per the rules. "coagusta[?]tum" is uncertain, and "Triplicē" with its tilde is uncertain.
